description: This is a PHP unit test class for the VacancyRestController in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It contains test methods to verify the behavior of GET requests handling specific vacancy IDs, as well as ensuring that POST, PUT, and DELETE methods throw NotImplementedExceptions as expected.

classes.name: VacancyRestControllerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the VacancyRestController API endpoints related to recruitment vacancies in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures by populating test data from a YAML fixture file before any tests run.

methods.name: testHandleGetRequest
methods.description: Tests the handleGetRequest method of the VacancyRestController with various vacancy IDs and asserts the correctness of the data returned or exceptions thrown.

methods.name: testHandlePutRequest
methods.description: Ensures that handlePutRequest throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testInitPutValidationRule
methods.description: Ensures that initPutValidationRule throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testHandlePostRequest
methods.description: Ensures that handlePostRequest (misnamed as handlePutRequest in the test) throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testInitPostValidationRule
methods.description: Ensures that initPostValidationRule throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testHandleDeleteRequest
methods.description: Ensures that handleDeleteRequest (misnamed as handlePutRequest in the test) throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testInitDeleteValidationRule
methods.description: Ensures that initDeleteValidationRule (misnamed as initPutValidationRule in the test) throws a NotImplementedException.
